transport: NMEA 2000, Micro-C 4-pin male connector on the Combox and on the Xantrex Gateway. No bit rate, PGN list, or instance scheme in any Xantrex document.

models.name: Freedom X / XC Marine inverters behind it (817-1050, 817-2080, 817-2080-12)

gotchas: Same product, two SKUs, two buses: 808-0822 is RV-C, 808-0822-01 is NMEA 2000. They are not interchangeable and the datasheet notes 817-1050 / 817-2080 / 817-2080-12 are 'compatible with 808-0822 only'.
PGN definitions are NMEA's, not Xantrex's, and NMEA 2000 message definitions are licensed. Vendor gives you the connector and nothing more.

Listed separately from the RV-C entry because a Combox on the marine SKU speaks a different application layer over the same CAN wire. Grouping them would be exactly the 'same vendor, same family name' error.
